title: Pan-Seared Fish with Dutch-Style Pilaf and Spherified Sauce
description: A flavorful and exotic fish dish with a crispy crust, served with a flavorful pilaf and a tangy spherified sauce.

ingredients.name: Spherified Sauce Mix
ingredients.notes: Make according to the package instructions

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, prepare the Dutch-Style Pilaf according to the package instructions.
To make the spherified sauce, follow the package instructions.
Serve the fish on top of the pilaf and with a side of spherified sauce.
